A  National  Senior  Certificate  (NSC)  (Degree  endorsement)  with  at  least  50%  in  the  language  of  teaching  and  learning  and  with  at  least  50%  in  Mathematics, or a  Senior  Certificate  (SC)  with  matriculation  exemption  (or  qualify  for  the  exemption  from  the  Matriculation  Board)  and  with  at  least  a  D  symbol  on  HG  or  a  C  symbol  on  SG  in  the  language  of  teaching  and  learning  and  with  at  least  a  D  symbol  on  HG  or  a  C  symbol  on  SG  in  Mathematics, or any  completed  Higher  Certificate  offered  in  the  College  of  Economic  and  Management  Sciences, or any  Diploma  obtained  in  the  College  of  Economic  and  Management  Sciences. For  more  information  on  RPL  criteria  visit: http://www.unisa.ac.za/rpl

notes: Qualification list from https://www.unisa.ac.za/sites/corporate/default/Apply-for-admission/Undergraduate-qualifications/Qualifications/All-qualifications, 224 entries, all mapped to a real QualificationType (advancedCertificate and postgraduateCertificate now exist in lib/firestore/types.ts, so the 39 entries previously under unmappedQualifications are now ordinary programmes). facultyId/schoolId are null on every entry: investigated the list's own accordion structure (grouped by qualification level, not college), per-item data attributes (none present), and each qualification's detail page (no college mention) -- no reliable college-to-qualification source was found via static HTML; the visible 'College' filter dropdown is not backed by data this scraper could read. A small number of entries whose real name has its own descriptive parenthetical before the official code (e.g. '...Psychology and Physiology (with Genetics) (98053 - ...)') may have that first parenthetical mis-captured as qualificationCode -- spot-check codes before relying on them.

Detail-page enrichment: 224/224 qualifications got at least one of nqfLevel/minAps from their own detail page; 0 detail-page fetches failed outright after retries (those entries have a per-programme note saying so, and no enrichment fields). campuses, careerOutcomes, and applyUrl are null on every entry: UNISA is a distance-learning institution with no campus-specific qualifications (so 'campuses' doesn't apply the way it does for a contact university), no qualification page stated a structured list of career outcomes (only general purpose-statement prose, which wasn't confident enough to extract as discrete outcomes), and 'Apply now' links to one central application tool shared by every qualification, not a qualification-specific URL -- using the institution's own already-known applicationPortalUrl for that, not a fabricated per-programme link.

Second-pass faculty linkage: crawled each of the 7 colleges' own pages plus up to 10 of their own sub-pages each (prioritized by whether the link text/path suggested qualification/school/programme content), checking for each programme's own qualification code as a verbatim match -- not a name-based guess. Result: 4/224 programmes got a facultyId this way (their qualification code appeared on exactly one college's pages), 0 were ambiguous (code appeared under more than one college -- left null, noted per-programme), and 220 genuinely weren't found mentioned on any college page this pass checked (left null, no note added per-programme for this group since it's the expected default state, not a new finding). schoolId was not attempted: no college sub-page checked listed qualifications grouped by school/department, only by college.
